name: MapComponent lifecycle
description: Android Activity-style lifecycle management for map components, controlling initialization, teardown, and visibility state transitions.

name: CotDispatcher event bus
description: Internal event bus for routing Cursor-on-Target events between components, supporting filtered subscriptions and priority handling.

name: Intent-based inter-component communication
description: Standard Android Intent mechanism for loosely-coupled communication between ATAK components and plugins.

name: SharedPreferences configuration
description: Persistent key-value configuration storage for user preferences, connection settings, and component state.

name: IconsetDatabase
description: SQLite-backed database storing icon sets, user-defined icons, and iconset metadata for map symbology rendering.

name: CoT event parsing pipeline
description: Pipeline for parsing incoming CoT XML events, validating schema conformance, and dispatching structured event objects.

name: Map renderer integration
description: Hardware-accelerated map rendering using OpenGL ES via GLSurfaceView for 2D/3D map display and overlay compositing.

name: Plugin framework
description: Platform-specific plugin loading framework using Android BroadcastReceiver for ATAK and Managed Extensibility Framework for WinTAK.

name: DropDown/DockPane UI framework
description: UI panel management framework providing slide-out drop-down panels in ATAK and dockable panes in WinTAK for plugin user interfaces.

name: Tool/toolbar registration
mechanism: ActionBar and toolbar item registration API
description: Registration system for adding tools, toolbar buttons, and menu items to the main ATAK/WinTAK interface chrome.
